fr.L: pour votre agrément, [ce sera] un mâle sans défaut, du gros bétail, des moutons ou des chèvres.
fr.B: alors, pour que vous soyez agréés, ce devra être un mâle sans défaut, pris dans le gros bétail, les moutons ou les chèvres.
fr.R: Pour être accepté, l’animal doit être un mâle qui n’a rien d’abîmé. Ce doit être un de vos bœufs, de vos moutons ou de vos chèvres.

sw.L: kwa kukubaliwa kwenu, [atakuwa] asiye na kasoro, dume, katika ng'ombe, katika kondoo, au katika mbuzi.
sw.B: basi, ili mkubaliwe, atakuwa dume asiye na kasoro, wa ng'ombe, wa kondoo au wa mbuzi.
sw.R: Ili akubaliwe, mnyama huyo lazima awe dume asiye na tatizo lolote. Lazima awe mmoja wa ng'ombe wenu, kondoo wenu au mbuzi wenu.

decisions.choice: for your acceptance: so that God accepts you, the ones who offer
alternatives: so that it will be accepted for you
decisions.reason: The word means favor, goodwill or acceptance. With "your" it is the worshiper who is accepted, not only the animal (1:3-4): God receives the person through the offering. The phrase is the key to verses 19-29. An offering with a defect is "not for your acceptance" (verse 20), and the thanksgiving offering must be made "for your acceptance" (verse 29). Offering God something damaged is offering him what he will not accept (Malachi 1:8, 13).

decisions.choice: unblemished, a male: the rule for a burnt offering
decisions.reason: A burnt offering from the herd or the flock must be a male without defect (1:3, 10). On "unblemished" see 1:3; verses 22-24 list what counts as a defect.

decisions.choice: for your acceptance, ... / then, to be accepted for you, ...
decisions.reason: Verse 19 completes the sentence begun in verse 18. Literal keeps the Hebrew order and supplies "it shall be"; Balanced adds "then" to show where the ruling begins. Readable starts a new sentence.

source.text: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א תַקְרִ֑יבוּ כִּי־לֹ֥א לְרָצ֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: All that in it [is a] blemish not you will bring near, for not for acceptance it will be for you.

en.L: Anything that has a blemish in it you shall not bring near, for it will not be for acceptance for you.
en.B: Whatever has a defect you must not offer; it will not win acceptance for you.
en.R: Do not bring any animal that has something wrong with it. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will not accept it from you.

es.L: Nada que tenga en sí defecto {{plural_you:presentarán|presentaréis}}, porque no será para {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} aceptación.
es.B: No {{plural_you:ofrecerán|ofreceréis}} nada que tenga un defecto, pues no {{plural_you:les|os}} servirá para ser aceptados.
es.R: No {{plural_you:traigan|traigáis}} ningún animal que tenga algo malo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} aceptará.

fr.L: Tout ce qui a en lui un défaut, vous ne le ferez pas approcher, car ce ne sera pas pour votre agrément.
fr.B: Vous n’offrirez rien qui ait un défaut ; cela ne vous vaudrait pas d’être agréés.
fr.R: N’apportez aucun animal qui a quelque chose qui ne va pas. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne l’acceptera pas de vous.

sw.L: Kila kilicho na kasoro ndani yake hamtakisogeza, kwa maana hakitakuwa kwa kukubaliwa kwenu.
sw.B: Msitoe chochote chenye kasoro; hakitawapatia kukubaliwa.
sw.R: Msilete mnyama yeyote mwenye tatizo lolote. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatampokea kutoka kwenu.

decisions.choice: a blemish: any physical defect
decisions.reason: The word means a flaw or defect of the body, in an animal or a person (21:17-23; 24:19-20). Verses 22-24 list examples. It is the opposite of "unblemished" (1:3).

decisions.choice: The LORD will not accept it
decisions.reason: Readable makes the LORD the subject. He is the one who accepts or refuses (verse 19).

source.text: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יַקְרִ֤יב זֶֽבַח־שְׁלָמִים֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֨דֶר֙ א֣וֹ לִנְדָבָ֔ה בַּבָּקָ֖ר א֣וֹ בַצֹּ֑אן תָּמִ֤ים יִֽהְיֶה֙ לְרָצ֔וֹן כָּל־מ֖וּם לֹ֥א יִהְיֶה־בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] man, when he brings near [a] sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to fulfill [a] vow or for [a] freewill offering, in the herd or in the flock, unblemished it will be for acceptance; any blemish not will be in it.

en.L: And if {{gender:anyone|a man}} brings near a sacrifice of peace offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering, from the herd or from the flock, it shall be unblemished to be accepted; there shall be no blemish in it.
en.B: If {{gender:anyone|any man}} brings {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a peace offering from the herd or the flock, whether to pay a vow or as a freewill offering, the animal must be without defect if it is to be accepted. There must be nothing at all wrong with it.
en.R: {{gender:Someone|A man}} may bring a peace offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the cattle or the sheep and goats. That person may be keeping a promise or giving a gift. The animal must have nothing wrong with it, or {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not accept it. It must not have any flaw at all.

es.L: Y si {{gender:alguien|un hombre}} presenta un sacrificio de paz {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} para cumplir un voto o como ofrenda voluntaria, de la vacada o del rebaño, será sin defecto para ser aceptado; no habrá en él ningún defecto.
es.B: Si {{gender:alguien|algún hombre}} trae {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un sacrificio de paz del ganado vacuno o del ganado menor, ya sea para cumplir un voto o como ofrenda voluntaria, el animal tendrá que ser sin defecto para ser aceptado. No deberá tener nada malo.
es.R: {{gender:Alguien|Un hombre}} puede traer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un sacrificio de paz de sus vacas o de sus ovejas y cabras. Esa persona tal vez cumple una promesa o hace un regalo. El animal no debe tener nada malo, o {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no lo aceptará. No debe tener ningún defecto.

fr.L: Et si {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} fait approcher un sacrifice de communion {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour accomplir un vœu ou comme offrande volontaire, du gros bétail ou du petit bétail, il sera sans défaut, pour être agréé ; il n’y aura en lui aucun défaut.
fr.B: Si {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} apporte {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un sacrifice de communion pris dans le gros ou le petit bétail, que ce soit pour accomplir un vœu ou comme offrande volontaire, l’animal devra être sans défaut pour être agréé. Il ne devra rien avoir d’abîmé.
fr.R: {{gender:Quelqu’un|Un homme}} peut apporter {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un sacrifice de communion pris parmi les bœufs ou parmi les moutons et les chèvres. Cette personne tient peut-être une promesse, ou fait un don. L’animal ne doit rien avoir d’abîmé, sinon {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne l’acceptera pas. Il ne doit avoir aucun défaut.

sw.L: Na mtu akimsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu ya sadaka za amani ili kutimiza nadhiri au kuwa sadaka ya hiari, katika ng'ombe au katika kondoo na mbuzi, atakuwa asiye na kasoro ili akubaliwe; kasoro yoyote haitakuwa ndani yake.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote akimletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya amani kutoka kwa ng'ombe au kwa kondoo na mbuzi, iwe ni kutimiza nadhiri au kuwa sadaka ya hiari, mnyama huyo atakuwa asiye na kasoro ili akubaliwe. Asiwe na kasoro yoyote kabisa.
sw.R: Mtu anaweza kumletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya amani kutoka kwa ng'ombe au kwa kondoo na mbuzi. Huenda anatimiza ahadi au anatoa zawadi. Mnyama huyo lazima asiwe na tatizo lolote, la sivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatamkubali. Asiwe na kasoro yoyote hata kidogo.

decisions.choice: to fulfill a vow: to pay what was promised
decisions.reason: The verb is used in 27:2 and Numbers 6:2; 15:3, 8 with "vow". It may mean to carry out a vow, or to make a special vow, one set apart from the ordinary. Here, with an offering already being brought, carrying out the vow fits best.

decisions.choice: unblemished for acceptance: the same rule for peace offerings as for burnt offerings
decisions.reason: The peace offering (3:1), of either sex (3:1, 6), must be just as sound as the burnt offering. Only for the freewill offering is a small exception allowed (verse 23). On "for acceptance" see verse 19.

decisions.choice: anyone / any man
decisions.reason: As in verse 18, the default is inclusive.

source.text: עַוֶּרֶת֩ א֨וֹ שָׁב֜וּר אוֹ־חָר֣וּץ אֽוֹ־יַבֶּ֗לֶת א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת לֹא־תַקְרִ֥יבוּ אֵ֖לֶּה לַיהוָ֑ה וְאִשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא־תִתְּנ֥וּ מֵהֶ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Blindness or broken or maimed or running [sore] or itch or scab, not you will bring near these to Yahweh, and [a] fire offering not you will give of them on the altar to Yahweh.

en.L: Blind or broken or maimed or with a running sore or a festering rash or scabs, these you shall not bring near to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and an offering by fire of them you shall not give on the altar to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: You must not present to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} an animal that is blind, has a broken limb or is maimed, or one with a running sore, a festering rash or scabs. Do not give any of them to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a food offering on the altar.
en.R: Do not offer {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} an animal that is blind, has a broken bone, or has been badly cut. Do not offer one with an oozing wound, a bad skin rash, or sores. Never put such an animal on the altar as a food offering burned for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Ciego, o quebrado, o mutilado, o con llaga supurante, o con sarpullido purulento, o con costras, estos no los {{plural_you:presentarán|presentaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, ni de ellos {{plural_you:darán|daréis}} ofrenda quemada sobre el altar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: No {{plural_you:presentarán|presentaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un animal ciego, con un miembro roto o mutilado, ni uno con una llaga que supura, un sarpullido purulento o costras. No {{plural_you:darán|daréis}} ninguno de ellos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como ofrenda quemada sobre el altar.
es.R: No le {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofrezcáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un animal ciego, con un hueso roto o con un corte grave. No {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofrezcáis}} uno que tenga una herida que supura, un sarpullido feo o costras. Nunca {{plural_you:pongan|pongáis}} un animal así sobre el altar como ofrenda quemada en el fuego para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Aveugle, ou fracturé, ou mutilé, ou ayant une plaie qui coule, ou une éruption purulente, ou des croûtes, ceux-là, vous ne les ferez pas approcher {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et vous n’en donnerez pas en offrande consumée par le feu sur l’autel {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Vous ne présenterez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} aucune bête aveugle, qui a un membre cassé ou qui est mutilée, ni aucune qui a une plaie suintante, une éruption purulente ou des croûtes. Vous n’en donnerez aucune {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} en offrande consumée par le feu sur l’autel.
fr.R: N’offrez pas {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un animal aveugle, qui a un os cassé ou une profonde coupure. N’en offrez pas un qui a une plaie qui coule, une vilaine éruption sur la peau ou des croûtes. Ne mettez jamais un tel animal sur l’autel comme offrande brûlée sur le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kipofu, au aliyevunjika, au aliyelemazwa, au mwenye kidonda kinachotoa majimaji, au upele unaotunga usaha, au vigaga, hao hamtamsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wala hamtatoa katika hao sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto juu ya madhabahu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Msimtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mnyama kipofu, aliyevunjika kiungo au aliyelemazwa, wala mwenye kidonda kinachotoa majimaji, upele unaotunga usaha au vigaga. Msimtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yeyote kati yao kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto juu ya madhabahu.
sw.R: Msimtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mnyama kipofu, aliyevunjika mfupa, au aliyekatwa vibaya. Msimtolee mwenye kidonda kinachotoa majimaji, upele mbaya wa ngozi, au vigaga. Kamwe msimweke mnyama wa namna hiyo juu ya madhabahu kuwa sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: blind, broken, maimed: defects of sight and limb
decisions.reason: The first word is clear. The second means broken, most likely a broken bone or limb. The third comes from a verb meaning to cut or to sharpen, and occurs only here. It probably means an animal with a cut or a mutilated part, but the exact injury is not known.

decisions.choice: running sore, festering rash, scabs: skin conditions, the exact kinds unknown
decisions.reason: The first word occurs only here. It comes from a verb meaning to flow, and so may be a running sore, though wart has also been suggested. The second and third are the festering rash and scabs of 21:20 (see the note there; compare Deuteronomy 28:27). They are the same kinds of defect that bar a priest from serving at the altar (21:18-20).

decisions.choice: a broken limb, maimed (Balanced); a broken bone, badly cut, an oozing wound, a bad skin rash (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable describe the defects in common words, following m1 and m2, and use the same words as 21:20 for the festering rash and scabs. Literal keeps the bare words, as the Hebrew lists them.

decisions.choice: "ciego", "quebrado" / "con un miembro roto", "mutilado", "llaga supurante", "sarpullido purulento", "costras"
decisions.reason: The exact defects are uncertain (m1, m2). Spanish follows the English descriptions; Readable says "un corte grave" and "una herida que supura". The same words are meant for the parallel list in 21:20.

decisions.choice: "aveugle", "fracturé" / "un membre cassé", "mutilé", "une plaie qui coule" / "suintante", "une éruption purulente", "des croûtes"
decisions.reason: The exact defects are uncertain (m1, m2). French follows the English descriptions and avoids traditional words such as "dartre" and "gale" that name a particular disease. The same words are meant for the parallel list in 21:20.

decisions.choice: "kipofu", "aliyevunjika (kiungo)", "aliyelemazwa", "kidonda kinachotoa majimaji", "upele unaotunga usaha", "vigaga"
decisions.reason: The exact defects are uncertain (m1, m2). Swahili follows the English descriptions; Readable says "aliyekatwa vibaya" and "upele mbaya wa ngozi". The same words are meant for the parallel list in 21:20.

source.text: וְשׁ֥וֹר וָשֶׂ֖ה שָׂר֣וּעַ וְקָל֑וּט נְדָבָה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וּלְנֵ֖דֶר לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [an] ox or [a] sheep, overgrown or stunted, [a] freewill offering you may make it, and for [a] vow not it will be accepted.

en.L: And an ox or a sheep with a limb too long or stunted, you may offer it [as] a freewill offering, but for a vow it will not be accepted.
en.B: If an ox or a sheep has a limb too long or stunted, you may still give it as a freewill offering. For a vow, though, it will not be accepted.
en.R: You may give an ox or a sheep that has one leg too long or too short as a gift you choose to give. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not accept it when you are keeping a promise.

es.L: Y un buey o una oveja con un miembro demasiado largo o atrofiado, lo podrás ofrecer [como] ofrenda voluntaria, pero por un voto no será aceptado.
es.B: Si un buey o una oveja tiene un miembro demasiado largo o atrofiado, podrás darlo de todos modos como ofrenda voluntaria. Pero para un voto no será aceptado.
es.R: Puedes dar un buey o una oveja que tenga una pata demasiado larga o demasiado corta como un regalo que eliges hacer. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no lo aceptará cuando estés cumpliendo una promesa.

fr.L: Et un bœuf ou un mouton ayant un membre trop long ou atrophié, tu pourras l’offrir [en] offrande volontaire, mais pour un vœu il ne sera pas agréé.
fr.B: Si un bœuf ou un mouton a un membre trop long ou atrophié, tu pourras quand même le donner comme offrande volontaire. Mais pour un vœu, il ne sera pas agréé.
fr.R: Tu peux donner un bœuf ou un mouton qui a une patte trop longue ou trop courte, comme un don que tu choisis de faire. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne l’acceptera pas quand tu tiens une promesse.

sw.L: Na ng'ombe au kondoo mwenye kiungo kirefu kupita kiasi au kilichodumaa, waweza kumtoa [kuwa] sadaka ya hiari, lakini kwa nadhiri hatakubaliwa.
sw.B: Ng'ombe au kondoo akiwa na kiungo kirefu kupita kiasi au kilichodumaa, bado unaweza kumtoa kuwa sadaka ya hiari. Lakini kwa nadhiri hatakubaliwa.
sw.R: Unaweza kutoa ng'ombe au kondoo mwenye mguu mmoja mrefu mno au mfupi mno kuwa zawadi unayochagua kuitoa. Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatamkubali unapotimiza ahadi.

decisions.choice: a limb too long or stunted: a part of the body too long or too short
alternatives: with a limb too long or too short
decisions.reason: The first word is used in 21:18 of a defect in a priest (see the note there). It seems to mean that a limb has grown too long or out of proportion. The second, found only here, seems to mean shrunken or stunted. The part of the body is not named.

decisions.choice: accepted as a freewill offering, but not for a vow
decisions.reason: A freewill offering is a gift freely given, so a slight defect may be allowed. A vow pays a debt already owed to God, and what is owed must be whole (Malachi 1:14). Only a defect of growth is allowed this way, not the defects of verses 22 and 24.

decisions.choice: one leg too long or too short
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likely sense, following m1. As in 21:18, it speaks of a leg, since the Hebrew does not say which part.

source.text: וּמָע֤וּךְ וְכָתוּת֙ וְנָת֣וּק וְכָר֔וּת לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֖יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּֽבְאַרְצְכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And squeezed and crushed and torn and cut not you will bring near to Yahweh, and in your land not you will do [it].

en.L: And [an animal that is] squeezed or crushed or torn or cut you shall not bring near to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and in your land you shall not do [it].
en.B: Do not bring {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} an animal whose testicles have been squeezed, crushed, torn or cut off. Do not do so in your land.
en.R: Do not bring {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a male animal that can no longer father young because its testicles were bruised, crushed, torn, or cut. Do not do this in your land.

es.L: Y [un animal] magullado, o aplastado, o desgarrado, o cortado, no lo {{plural_you:presentarán|presentaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; y en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra no [lo] {{plural_you:harán|haréis}}.
es.B: No {{plural_you:presentarán|presentaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un animal cuyos testículos hayan sido magullados, aplastados, arrancados o cortados. No {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} eso en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra.
es.R: No le {{plural_you:traigan|traigáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un animal macho que ya no pueda tener crías porque le magullaron, aplastaron, arrancaron o cortaron los testículos. No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} esto en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra.

fr.L: Et [une bête] froissée, ou écrasée, ou arrachée, ou coupée, vous ne la ferez pas approcher {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; et dans votre pays vous ne [le] ferez pas.
fr.B: Vous ne présenterez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} aucune bête dont les testicules ont été froissés, écrasés, arrachés ou coupés. Vous ne ferez pas cela dans votre pays.
fr.R: N’apportez pas {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un animal mâle qui ne peut plus avoir de petits parce que ses testicules ont été meurtris, écrasés, arrachés ou coupés. Ne faites pas cela dans votre pays.

sw.L: Na [mnyama] aliyebanwa, au aliyepondwa, au aliyeraruliwa, au aliyekatwa, hamtamsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; wala katika nchi yenu hamtafanya [hivyo].
sw.B: Msimletee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mnyama ambaye korodani zake zimebanwa, zimepondwa, zimeraruliwa au zimekatwa. Msifanye hivyo katika nchi yenu.
sw.R: Msimletee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mnyama dume asiyeweza tena kuzaa kwa sababu korodani zake zilibanwa, zilipondwa, zilichanwa au zilikatwa. Msifanye hivyo katika nchi yenu.

decisions.choice: squeezed, crushed, torn, cut: ways of castrating an animal
decisions.reason: The part of the body is not named, but the four words most likely describe damage to the testicles, the ways an animal could be castrated. Compare 21:20, crushed testicles in a priest. Deuteronomy 23:1 bars a man with crushed or cut-off sex organs from the assembly, using related words. The Hebrew joins the words with "and", but each is a separate case.

decisions.choice: in your land you shall not do it: do not offer such animals, or do not castrate animals at all
alternatives: you shall not castrate animals in your land
decisions.reason: "Do it" may refer to offering such animals: they are not to be offered anywhere in the land. It may instead forbid castrating animals in Israel. The words allow both, and Balanced and Readable keep them as open as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: whose testicles; that can no longer father young
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name what the Hebrew leaves unnamed, following m1. Readable says what the injury means for the animal.

source.text: וּמִיַּ֣ד בֶּן־נֵכָ֗ר לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֛יבוּ אֶת־לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֣י מָשְׁחָתָ֤ם בָּהֶם֙ מ֣וּם בָּ֔ם לֹ֥א יֵרָצ֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And from [the] hand of [a] son of foreignness not you will bring near [the] food of your God from any of these, for their corruption [is] in them, [a] blemish [is] in them; not they will be accepted for you.

en.L: And from the hand of a foreigner you shall not bring near the food of your God from any of these, for their corruption [is] in them, a blemish [is] in them; they will not be accepted for you.'"
en.B: Do not take any of these animals from a foreigner either, and present them as the food of your God. They are damaged; they have a defect and will not be accepted for you.'"
en.R: Do not take animals like these from a foreigner and offer them as the food of your God. They are damaged and have something wrong with them. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will not accept them from you.'"

es.L: Y de mano de un extranjero no {{plural_you:presentarán|presentaréis}} como alimento de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios ninguno de estos, porque su corrupción [está] en ellos, defecto [hay] en ellos; no serán aceptados para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}”».
es.B: Tampoco {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} de un extranjero ninguno de estos animales para presentarlos como alimento de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios. Están dañados; tienen un defecto y no serán aceptados para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}”».
es.R: No {{plural_you:tomen|toméis}} de un extranjero animales como estos para ofrecerlos como alimento de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios. Están dañados y tienen algo malo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no {{plural_you:se los|os los}} aceptará”».

fr.L: Et de la main d’un étranger, vous ne ferez approcher aucune de ces [bêtes] comme nourriture de votre Dieu, car leur corruption [est] en elles, un défaut [est] en elles ; elles ne seront pas agréées pour vous.” »
fr.B: Vous ne prendrez pas non plus de telles bêtes des mains d’un étranger pour les présenter comme nourriture de votre Dieu. Elles sont abîmées ; elles ont un défaut et ne seront pas agréées pour vous.” »
fr.R: Ne prenez pas de tels animaux à un étranger pour les offrir comme nourriture de votre Dieu. Ils sont abîmés et ont quelque chose qui ne va pas. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne les acceptera pas de vous.” »

sw.L: Wala kutoka mkononi mwa mtu wa kigeni hamtasogeza chakula cha Mungu wenu katika hao wote, kwa maana uharibifu wao [u] ndani yao, kasoro [i] ndani yao; hawatakubaliwa kwa ajili yenu.'"
sw.B: Wala msipokee kutoka kwa mtu wa taifa jingine wanyama kama hao na kuwatoa kuwa chakula cha Mungu wenu. Wameharibika; wana kasoro, nao hawatakubaliwa kwa ajili yenu.'"
sw.R: Msichukue wanyama kama hao kutoka kwa mtu wa taifa jingine na kuwatoa kuwa chakula cha Mungu wenu. Wameharibika na wana kasoro. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawapokea kutoka kwenu.'"

decisions.choice: from the hand of a foreigner: animals obtained from a foreigner
decisions.reason: A foreigner is someone from another nation, not the outsider who lives among Israel (verse 18). Defective animals bought or received from a foreigner are no more acceptable than Israel's own. The phrase may also mean offerings that foreigners themselves bring through the priests.

decisions.choice: the food of your God: what is offered to God on the altar
decisions.reason: The offerings are called God's food (3:11; 21:6, 8, 17), the food set on his table (see 21:6). This does not mean God needs to eat (Psalm 50:12-13). It is what the people give to him, and it must be fit for him.

decisions.choice: their corruption: they are spoiled or damaged
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to ruin or spoil. The animals are marred by a defect.

decisions.choice: The LORD will not accept them
decisions.reason: As in verse 20, Readable makes the LORD the subject.

decisions.choice: "un extranjero"
decisions.reason: In this chapter the sojourner who lives among Israel (verse 18) is "inmigrante", so that "extranjero" can mark the foreigner of another nation (m1).

decisions.choice: "un étranger"
decisions.reason: In this chapter the sojourner who lives among Israel (verse 18) is "immigré", so that "étranger" can mark the foreigner of another nation (m1).

decisions.choice: "mtu wa kigeni" (L); "mtu wa taifa jingine" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Mgeni" is kept for the sojourner who lives among Israel (verse 18); the foreigner here belongs to another nation (m1), so Swahili says so.

en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Moses. He said,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses,

es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés:

fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Moïse. Il dit :

sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema na Musa. Akasema,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa,

decisions.choice: spoke ... saying: a third speech
decisions.reason: A last speech in this chapter, on young animals and the thanksgiving offering, runs to verse 33.

source.text: שׁ֣וֹר אוֹ־כֶ֤שֶׂב אוֹ־עֵז֙ כִּ֣י יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֛ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת אִמּ֑וֹ וּמִיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ וָהָ֔לְאָה יֵרָצֶ֕ה לְקָרְבַּ֥ן אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [An] ox or [a] sheep or [a] goat, when it is born, and it will be seven days under its mother, and from [the] day the eighth and onward it will be accepted for [an] offering of [a] fire offering to Yahweh.

en.L: "An ox or a sheep or a goat, when it is born, shall be seven days under its mother, and from the eighth day onward it will be accepted as an offering, an offering by fire, to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: "A newborn calf, lamb or kid is to be left with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be accepted as an offering, a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: "A baby calf, lamb, or goat must stay with its mother for its first seven days. From the eighth day on, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will accept it as a food offering burned on the altar.

es.L: «Un buey, o una oveja, o una cabra, cuando nazca, estará siete días bajo su madre, y desde el día octavo en adelante será aceptado como ofrenda, ofrenda quemada, para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: «El ternero, el cordero o el cabrito recién nacido se quedará siete días con su madre. Desde el octavo día en adelante será aceptado como ofrenda, como ofrenda quemada para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: «Un ternerito, un corderito o un cabrito tiene que quedarse con su madre sus primeros siete días. Desde el octavo día, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo aceptará como ofrenda quemada en el fuego.

fr.L: « Un bœuf, ou un mouton, ou une chèvre, quand il naîtra, restera sept jours sous sa mère, et à partir du huitième jour et au-delà il sera agréé comme offrande, offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: « Le veau, l’agneau ou le chevreau nouveau-né restera sept jours avec sa mère. À partir du huitième jour, il sera agréé comme offrande, une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: « Un petit veau, un agneau ou un chevreau doit rester avec sa mère pendant ses sept premiers jours. À partir du huitième jour, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’acceptera comme offrande brûlée sur le feu.

sw.L: "Ng'ombe, au kondoo, au mbuzi, atakapozaliwa, atakaa siku saba chini ya mama yake, na tangu siku ya nane na kuendelea atakubaliwa kuwa sadaka, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: "Ndama, mwanakondoo au mwana-mbuzi aliyezaliwa ataachwa na mama yake kwa siku saba. Tangu siku ya nane na kuendelea atakubaliwa kuwa sadaka, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: "Ndama mchanga, mwanakondoo au mwana-mbuzi lazima akae na mama yake siku saba za kwanza. Tangu siku ya nane, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atamkubali kuwa sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto.

decisions.choice: seven days under its mother: a newborn animal is left with its mother for its first week
decisions.reason: The same rule is given for firstborn animals in Exodus 22:30. A baby boy, likewise, is circumcised on the eighth day (12:3). The text gives no reason. It does show care for the mother and her young, and that a creature must live its first week before it is given to God.

decisions.choice: an ox, a sheep, a goat: here, a newborn of the herd or the flock
decisions.reason: The words name the kind of animal, not its age. Because they are newborn, they are a calf, a lamb and a kid.

decisions.choice: calf, lamb, kid (Balanced); baby calf, lamb, or goat (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the newborn animals, following m2. Literal keeps "an ox or a sheep or a goat".

decisions.choice: a food offering
decisions.reason: Literal keeps both words, "an offering, an offering by fire". Balanced keeps both with the settled "a food offering"; Readable gives one phrase.

source.text: וְשׁ֖וֹר אוֹ־שֶׂ֑ה אֹת֣וֹ וְאֶת־בְּנ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִשְׁחֲט֖וּ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And [an] ox or [a] sheep, it and its young not you will slaughter in day one.

en.L: And an ox or a sheep, it and its young you shall not slaughter in one day.
en.B: Whether from the herd or the flock, a mother animal and its young must not both be slaughtered in a single day.
en.R: Never kill a mother cow or sheep and its baby on the same day.

es.L: Y un buey o una oveja, a él y a su cría no {{plural_you:degollarán|degollaréis}} en un mismo día.
es.B: Ya sea del ganado vacuno o del ganado menor, no {{plural_you:degollarán|degollaréis}} el mismo día a la madre y a su cría.
es.R: Nunca {{plural_you:maten|matéis}} el mismo día a una vaca o una oveja y a su cría.

fr.L: Et un bœuf ou un mouton, lui et son petit, vous ne les égorgerez pas en un seul jour.
fr.B: Qu’il s’agisse du gros ou du petit bétail, vous n’égorgerez pas la mère et son petit le même jour.
fr.R: Ne tuez jamais le même jour une vache ou une brebis et son petit.

sw.L: Na ng'ombe au kondoo, yeye na mtoto wake hamtawachinja siku moja.
sw.B: Iwe ni katika ng'ombe au katika kondoo na mbuzi, msimchinje mnyama mama pamoja na mtoto wake siku moja.
sw.R: Kamwe msimchinje ng'ombe au kondoo mama pamoja na mtoto wake siku moja.

decisions.choice: it and its young: the mother and her offspring
alternatives: a parent animal and its young
decisions.reason: After verse 27, "it" is most naturally the mother of the young animal. The Hebrew pronoun is masculine, agreeing with "ox", the word for one of the herd of either sex. The law forbids killing a mother and her young on the same day, whether for sacrifice or for food.

decisions.choice: not in one day: one of several laws that protect a mother and her young
decisions.reason: Compare the law not to boil a young goat in its mother's milk (Exodus 23:19) and not to take a mother bird with her young (Deuteronomy 22:6-7). The text does not explain the reason, but these laws hold back from destroying parent and young together.

decisions.choice: a mother animal / a mother cow or sheep
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "mother", following m1.

source.text: וְכִֽי־תִזְבְּח֥וּ זֶֽבַח־תּוֹדָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And when you sacrifice [a] sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, for your acceptance you will sacrifice [it].

en.L: And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for your acceptance you shall sacrifice [it].
en.B: When you sacrifice a thanksgiving offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, do it in the way that will gain acceptance for you.
en.R: When you give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a thanksgiving offering, do it the right way, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will accept you.

es.L: Y cuando {{plural_you:sacrifiquen|sacrifiquéis}} sacrificio de acción de gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, para {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} aceptación lo {{plural_you:sacrificarán|sacrificaréis}}.
es.B: Cuando {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofrezcáis}} un sacrificio de acción de gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:háganlo|hacedlo}} de manera que {{plural_you:sean aceptados|seáis aceptados}}.
es.R: Cuando le {{plural_you:den|deis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un sacrificio para dar gracias, {{plural_you:háganlo|hacedlo}} como se debe, para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} acepte.

fr.L: Et quand vous sacrifierez un sacrifice d’action de grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vous [le] sacrifierez pour votre agrément.
fr.B: Quand vous offrirez un sacrifice d’action de grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, faites-le de manière à être agréés.
fr.R: Quand vous apportez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un sacrifice pour dire merci, faites-le comme il faut, pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous accepte.

sw.L: Na mtakapomchinjia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu ya shukrani, mtaichinja kwa kukubaliwa kwenu.
sw.B: Mnapomtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu ya shukrani, itoeni kwa namna itakayowapatia kukubaliwa.
sw.R: Mnapomletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya kutoa shukrani, ifanyeni kwa njia iliyo sawa, ili {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} awakubali.

decisions.choice: a sacrifice of thanksgiving: a peace offering given to thank God
decisions.reason: It is one kind of peace offering, brought to thank God for help given (7:11-15; Psalm 107:22; 116:17). Its meat was eaten by the worshiper and the household.

decisions.choice: for your acceptance: offered by the rule, so that God accepts you
decisions.reason: See verse 19. Here the rule meant is the one in verse 30.

decisions.choice: do it in the way that will gain acceptance for you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn "for your acceptance" into a clause; Readable makes the LORD the one who accepts.

source.text: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹֽא־תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּ֑קֶר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: On the day that it will be eaten; not you will leave over of it until morning; I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: On that day it shall be eaten; you shall not leave any of it until morning. I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Eat it on the day it is offered, and keep none of it until the next morning. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Eat all of it on the day you offer it. Do not save any for the next morning. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: En ese mismo día se comerá; no {{plural_you:dejarán|dejaréis}} nada de él hasta la mañana. Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Lo {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} el día en que se ofrezca, y no {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} nada para la mañana siguiente. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Cómanlo|Comedlo}} todo el mismo día en que lo {{plural_you:ofrecen|ofrecéis}}. No {{plural_you:guarden|guardéis}} nada para la mañana siguiente. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Le jour même, il sera mangé ; vous n’en laisserez rien jusqu’au matin. Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Vous le mangerez le jour où il est offert, et vous n’en garderez rien jusqu’au lendemain matin. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mangez-le tout entier le jour où vous l’offrez. N’en gardez rien pour le lendemain matin. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Siku hiyo hiyo italiwa; hamtaacha kitu chake mpaka asubuhi. Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtaila siku ile ile inapotolewa, wala msibakize chochote mpaka asubuhi. Mimi ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ileni yote siku ile ile mnayoitoa. Msibakize chochote hadi asubuhi. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: eaten on that day, none left until morning: the rule of 7:15
decisions.reason: The thanksgiving offering had to be eaten on the day it was offered (7:15). Other peace offerings could be eaten on the next day as well, but never on the third (7:16-18; 19:5-8).

source.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will keep my commandments and do them; I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And you shall keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments and do them. I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: You are to keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments and carry them out. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands and do what they say. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos y los {{plural_you:cumplirán|cumpliréis}}. Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Observarán|Observaréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos y los {{plural_you:pondrán|pondréis}} en práctica. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Obedezcan|Obedeced}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} lo que dicen. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et vous garderez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et vous les pratiquerez. Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Vous observerez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et vous les appliquerez. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Obéissez à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et faites ce qu’ils disent. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nanyi mtazishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kuzitenda. Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtazishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kuzifuata. Mimi ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Tiini amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kufanya yale zinayosema. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: keep and do: a closing call to obey
decisions.reason: The pair "keep and do" closes several sets of laws in this part of Leviticus (18:4-5; 19:37; 20:8, 22). It means both to guard the commandments and to carry them out.

source.text: וְלֹ֤א תְחַלְּלוּ֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֔י וְנִ֨קְדַּשְׁתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And not you will profane [the] name of my holiness, and I will be treated as holy in [the] midst of [the] sons of Israel; I [am] Yahweh [who] makes you holy,

en.L: And you shall not profane {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy name, and I will be treated as holy among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel. I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who makes you holy,
en.B: Never profane {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy name; among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} I must be treated as holy. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who makes you holy,
en.R: Do not dishonor {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy name. The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} must honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as holy. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who makes you holy.

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:profanarán|profanaréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo nombre, y seré tratado como santo en medio de los hijos de Israel. Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que {{plural_you:los|os}} santifica,
es.B: Nunca {{plural_you:profanen|profanéis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo nombre; entre los israelitas debo ser tratado como santo. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que {{plural_you:los|os}} santifica,
es.R: No {{plural_you:deshonren|deshonréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo nombre. Los israelitas tienen que reconocer {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santidad. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que {{plural_you:los|os}} hace santos.

decisions.choice: I will be treated as holy: Israel must honor God as holy
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 10:3, where God shows himself holy among the priests. Here it is set against "you shall not profane my holy name": God is treated as holy when his people keep his name from being made common. Elsewhere God shows his holiness by what he does (Ezekiel 20:41; 36:23).

decisions.choice: I am the LORD who makes you holy: Israel's holiness is God's work
decisions.reason: The phrase closes the laws on holiness (20:8; 21:8, 15, 23; 22:9, 16), and here it is said to the whole people. Israel is to be holy (19:2), but it is God who makes them holy, by choosing them, bringing them out of Egypt (verse 33) and living among them. The holiness asked of them answers the holiness he gives (Exodus 31:13). Keeping his commands is how they live in it (20:8).

decisions.choice: who brought you out of Egypt to be your God: the ground of all these laws
decisions.reason: God's claim on Israel rests on the exodus (11:45; 19:36; 25:38; Exodus 20:2). He brought them out not only to free them but to be their God, and so they are to be his holy people.
